nodes.label: SVG Icon Sprite Sheet
nodes.rationale: A single SVG containing multiple <symbol> definitions (bluesky, discord, documentation, github) referenced by id, so the app loads one sprite file and instantiates icons via <use> rather than shipping a file per icon. Brand glyphs use solid #08060d fills while UI glyphs use violet #aa3bff strokes - two distinct icon styles in one sheet.
